    What to Expect

    The Experience

    Our Story

    Built for those who expect more.

    House of Rose was founded with a clear mission: bring together clinical precision and genuine hospitality in a space that feels nothing like a standard medical office.

    Every touchpoint at House of Rose reflects a standard we hold ourselves to.

    Care Standard

    The House of Rose Standard

    Physician-Informed

    Every protocol is reviewed and supervised by our medical director. Science leads every decision.

    Truly Personalized

    No templates. No package pressure. Your protocol is designed around your biology and your goals.

    Unhurried by Design

    Appointments are scheduled with margin. You will never feel rushed, upsold, or overlooked.

    From First Contact to Ongoing Care

    Your Guest Journey

    01 - Inquiry

    Reach out by phone or email. A care coordinator responds within one business day.

    02 - Consultation

    A private 30-minute consultation with our clinical team. No upsell pressure, just listening and assessment.

    03 - Protocol Design

    Your personalized treatment plan is crafted and reviewed with you before any commitment.

    04 - First Appointment

    Arrive to a calm, private suite. Your provider walks you through every step at your pace.

    05 - Ongoing Care

    Check-ins, titration, and protocol adjustments as needed. You are never handed off to a stranger.
